name: ai-first-programming
description: A companion extension for the AI First Programming book series that provides easy access to book examples, prompts, and code responses. Includes a Language Model Chat Provider that returns exact code examples from the books.

commands.title: Focus on AI First Books Panel

aiFirst.trace.markdownDescription: Log the shape of each request VS Code sends to the AI First chat model (message roles, part types, offered tools, tool mode, matched example) to the **AI First Programming** output channel. Never logs your prompt text or file contents. Useful when reporting a problem with the chat model.

aiFirst.captureFixtures.markdownDescription: For extension maintainers testing compatibility only. Saves each full chat request, **including prompt text**, as JSON under the extension's global storage folder. Leave off.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with AI First Programming
walkthroughs.description: Get book examples into your code, with or without VS Code's chat

steps.title: Insert Book Code with Find Book Example
steps.description:
Paste a prompt from the book and insert its exact code into your file. No Copilot, sign-in or network needed.

[Find Book Example](command:ai-first-programming.findExample)

steps.title: Explore the Book Content
steps.description:
Open the AI First Books panel and navigate to the section for the language and book you are reading. The content is organized by book, section, chapter, and example.

[Open AI First Books Panel](command:ai-first-programming.focus)

steps.title: Open an Example
steps.description: Navigate through the sections and chapters in the tree view. Click on any example to view the detailed prompt and code response with syntax highlighting.

steps.title: Copy an Example Prompt
steps.description: Click **Copy Prompt** in the example view to copy the book's prompt, then paste it into Find Book Example or into chat. Each response also has an **Insert into Editor** button.

steps.title: Optional: Make the AI First Model Visible in Chat
steps.description:
To type book prompts into VS Code's chat, make the **AI First Programming** model visible. No GitHub sign-in needed.

1. Click the button to copy the command and open the Command Palette, then paste it and press Enter
2. Expand the **AI First** group and click the **eye icon** next to **AI First Programming**

If AI First is still missing from the chat model list, check that this setting is on. Restart VS Code if it still doesn't appear.

[Copy Command & Open Command Palette](command:ai-first-programming.copyManageModelsCommand)
[Check the setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22chat.agentHost.byokModels.enabled%22%5D)

steps.title: Optional: Use the AI First Model in Chat
steps.description:
Choose **AI First Programming** with the model button in each chat; VS Code remembers a separate choice per place, and **Auto** or **Copilot Fusion** write AI code instead of the book's.

**Inline chat:** save a `.py` or `.java` file (empty is fine), press `Ctrl+I` (`Cmd+I` on Mac), paste the prompt, then **Keep** or **Undo**.

**Chat panel:** paste the prompt, then hover over the code and click **Insert At Cursor** (`Ctrl+Enter`, `Cmd+Enter` on Mac). Avoid **Apply in Editor**, which asks a Copilot model to merge the code.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
